channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Article: Eliminating Long-Lived Credentials in GCP with Workload Identity Federation
item.description: Long-lived GCP service account keys are secrets that must be managed forever, are hard to rotate, and are easy to leak. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: IAM Roles Anywhere now provides a Java plugin for the AWS SDK
item.description: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) Roles Anywhere now provides a plugin for the AWS SDK for Java v2 that enables workloads running outside of AWS to obtain temporary AWS credentials directly within the Java application process. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Glue 5.1 is now available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud Region
item.description: AWS Glue 5.1 is now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud Region. AWS Glue is a serverless, scalable data integration service that simplifies discovering, preparing, moving, and integrating data from multiple sources. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Backup adds cross-Region backup copy and logically air-gapped vault support for Amazon DocumentDB in nine additional AWS Regions
item.description: AWS Backup now supports copying Amazon DocumentDB backups across AWS Regions and storing them in logically air-gapped vaults in nine additional AWS Regions: Asia Pacific (Hong Kong, Jakarta, Melbourne, Osaka), Europe (Spain, Stockholm,… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 R8id instances are now available in additional AWS Regions
item.description: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) R8id instances are now available in additional regions. R8id instances are now available in Asia Pacific (Mumbai, Malaysia, Sydney), Canada (Central), and Europe (Ireland, Stockholm). (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 C8id and M8id instances are now available in additional AWS Regions
item.description: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C8id and M8id instances with up to 22.8 TB of local NVMe-based SSD block-level storage are now available in additional regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Cloudflare Extends AI Search to Make it Easier for Agents and Developers to Search Custom Data
item.description: Cloudflare AI Search is a built-in search and retrieval service designed to give AI agents and applications a ready-to-use search engine over custom data. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports points-based scoring in performance evaluations
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now supports points-based scoring to evaluate human and AI agent performance, giving managers more flexibility in configuring evaluation scores. (1 source: aws)
